description: This file is a locale/culture configuration for the Date.js library tailored for the 'es-HN' (Spanish - Honduras) locale. It defines cultural conventions such as month names, day names, date formats, regex patterns for parsing dates, and related utility functions.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time components of the date to midnight.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the date's time components to the current system time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the date object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this date with another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if this date equals another date.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the day based on its name.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the month based on its name.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a given year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a given month of a year.

methods.name: getTimezoneAbbreviation
methods.description: Gets timezone abbreviation based on offset.

methods.name: getTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Returns the timezone offset for a given timezone name.
